text: On a bright street full of theaters. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy began to shout, dance, and sing. <break time="0.8s" /> As loudly as he could. <break time="0.8s" /> The policeman only turned his back. <break time="0.8s" /> And told a man. <break time="0.8s" /> That Soapy was a college student celebrating a victory. <break time="0.8s" /> They are noisy but harmless. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> And we have orders. <break time="0.8s" /> To leave them alone. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy stopped his useless noise. <break time="0.8s" /> In despair. <break time="0.8s" /> Wondering if he would ever reach the Island. <break time="0.8s" /> In a cigar store. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy saw a well dressed man. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had left his silk umbrella. <break time="0.8s" /> By the door. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy stepped inside. <break time="0.8s" /> Took the umbrella. <break time="0.8s" /> And walked slowly away. <break time="0.8s" /> And the man hurried after him. <break time="0.8s" /> That is my umbrella. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the man. <break time="0.8s" /> And Soapy told him to call the policeman. <break time="0.8s" /> Standing at the corner. <break time="0.8s" /> The man slowed down and said. <break time="0.8s" /> That he might have picked it up. <break time="0.8s" /> By mistake in a restaurant that morning. <break time="0.8s" /> If it is yours. <break time="0.8s" /> I hope you will excuse me. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> And he hurried back into the cigar store. <break time="0.8s" /> Feeling angry. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy threw the umbrella. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a hole in the road. <break time="0.8s" /> And complained about the police.
